page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Notes stand in the right margin: "Cenfura.", "Fraga", "quando", "affumen-" and "da ?". Page number at the top right. Running head at the top centre. Signature "T 4" and catchword "Quibus" at the foot.

main_text.p: sperfo:aliæ vino irrigant,facchariq; pollinem adiiciunt, quædam statim lectaac decerpta vorantur.Pulticulæ quoq; ex fragis concinnantur pro delicatioribus aduersus iecoris, stomachi,renumq; æstum[?] utiles. Cui etiam rei miré conducit aqua destillata, calentem enim nimis sanguinem refrigerat & recreat, faciẽq; plurimum rubentibus auxilio est.Hic verò errorem coarguere oportet, quod ple-Cenfura. riq; omnes potissimum feré Magnates secú- das suas mensas iis exornant, cum ut cerasa[?], mora,cæteraq; fugacia primo cibo fumi de-Fraga beant,aluum enim molliunt, refrigerant & quando humectant,sitimque leniunt, peracto enimaffumen- ptandio[?],aut cœna in corpus admissa putref-da ? cunt, morbisq; ex putredine excitatis seminaria ministrant. Adnotasse[?] præterea hoc in loco oportebit, fraga, ut quæ parum à terra distent,facilè à serpentibus,bufonibus, & id genus venenatis animalibus calcari, arrodique,nec tamen virus accipere, autalienum saporem affumere, quod argumento est nullamiis cum venenis esse cognationem: neq; enim scriptum aut auditum vsquam est, quenquam e[?]u horum veneno infectum fuisse. Nihilominus tamen decerpta, antequam deuorentur, frigidâ purâ abluantur.

page.notes: Left margin is empty. Right margin carries five notes: "Cenfura.", "Fraga", "quando", "affumen-", "da ?". Long s is written as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings marked [?]: page number (printed with a long-s-like final character); "æstum" (a word before "utiles"); "cerasa" (the last letters are blurred); "ptandio" (the first letters are unclear); "Adnotasse" (the ending is uncertain); "e[?]u" in "quenquam esu". The running head "PROROGANDA A." is printed at the top. The first word "sperfo:aliæ" is a fragment continuing from the previous page; its first letter is uncertain and may be "s" or "f".
